evidence_kind: Direct browser screenshots of publisher thumbnails; source page and download UI for strongest lead
animation: Metadata reports zero animations for each candidate; no model animation inspected.

observations.observed: Black elongated payment terminal with a large keypad privacy shield, small green screen and prominent receipt-printer body. Realistic worn material, no visible inserted card or payment gesture.
observations.disposition: Not selected for the current warm, clear isolated learning image. Dark retro styling and missing payment cue would require substantial adaptation.

observations.observed: Rounded gray terminal with large blank screen, numeric keypad and red/yellow/green keys on a dark support. Small brand/model text is visible. No inserted card or contactless gesture.
observations.disposition: Strongest bounded source lead for further model inspection. Still needs an identifiable card/payment cue, branding treatment and matching lighting/composition; no gameplay-size or downloaded-model approval.
observations.acquisition_observed: Original publisher page loaded in Edge. It describes a credit card (chip and PIN) reader, 12.9k triangles and 8.2k vertices, CC Attribution with CC BY 4.0 link. Clicking Download 3D Model opened a login dialog. No sign-in, model download or terms acceptance occurred.

observations.observed: Dark angular rectangular unit with a broad blank upper face and a gray lower panel outlined in red. No visible numeric keypad, card, payment action or useful screen content.
observations.disposition: Not selected from this preview: payment meaning is visually ambiguous and styling does not fit the established retail props.

limits: These are source preview observations, not acquired material, rendered WordCard acceptance, or permission to use trademarks. CC BY 4.0 and commercial attribution requirement were observed in publisher metadata; the strongest source page independently showed the same license link.
